quick_skim.title: Constraints on recovering quantum information after erasure
quick_skim.abstract: Suppose that we encode quantum information into $ n $ physical carriers. With what probabilities can we perfectly recover the quantum information after sets of carriers have been erased? This question arises in the study of quantum erasure channels, for which M.B. Hastings conjectured that if each carrier is independently erased with probability $ t \geq 1/2 $, then it is impossible to recover the quantum information with asymptotically vanishing error and probability $ > 1-t $. We prove this conjecture by establishing new no-cloning constraints on realizable recovery probabilities.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Proves Hasting's conjecture on erasure channels: if erasure probability >= 1/2, perfect recovery with vanishing error is impossible with probability > 1-t, via new no-cloning constraints.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该论文研究量子擦除信道中信息恢复的极限，证明了Hastings猜想：当每个载体独立擦除概率t≥1/2时，以渐近可忽略错误完美恢复量子信息的概率不可能超过1-t。通过建立新的不可克隆约束，论文为量子纠错编码在擦除信道下的性能提供了严格上界，对量子纠错编码的阈值分析具有重要理论意义。
